method: Same fixture entry bytes and 8 case/audience full-4K RGBA hashes per comparison; p95 is nearest rank; RSS/heap product stage maxima exclude boundary-crossing and tooling/after-workload phases.
attribution: Baseline has independent renderer/IO decode queues; reuse candidate combines global single-slot correction and paint reuse; final isolates queue/ownership correction without same-size paint reuse. Sequential machine measurements are not randomized causal proof.
